transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in the ATM system to protect users' finances and ensure operational integrity. Requirements SAF-01, SAF-02, and SAF-03 prevent negative balances and ensure users are informed about transaction failures. SAF-04 guarantees that all transactions are logged, facilitating accountability. SAF-05 secures user authentication and prevents unauthorized access. SAF-06 provides a mechanism for safe operation during maintenance, while SAF-07 ensures users are updated after transactions. Together, these requirements create a reliable and safe ATM environment for users.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for a seamless ATM experience, ensuring that transactions are processed swiftly while maintaining user satisfaction. EFF-01 emphasizes a maximum transaction processing time of 3 seconds, promoting responsiveness. EFF-02 ensures a high throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, which is essential for handling peak times effectively. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval for quick access to transaction history, minimizing latency. EFF-04 aligns with safety by preventing negative balances during transactions, while EFF-05 ensures immediate fund withdrawal from savings without user delay to enhance performance. EFF-06 provides real-time feedback on withdrawal requests exceeding available balances, and EFF-07 implements load balancing for effective request management.

conflicts_raised.description: Automatically withdrawing from the savings account without user confirmation can lead to user dissatisfaction and potential safety concerns.

transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are fundamental for the ATM system to ensure accountability and fairness. RES-01 mandates adherence to financial regulations, while RES-02 ensures comprehensive transaction logs for audit purposes. RES-03 prevents users from executing transactions that create negative balances, promoting fairness. RES-04 mandates secure PIN verification to protect user identity. RES-05 ensures withdrawals from the savings account only occur when sufficient funds are available, upholding ethical standards. RES-06 requires immediate user notification of insufficient funds, ensuring transparency. RES-07 emphasizes user privacy through encryption of personal data, reinforcing trust.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is essential for the ATM system to minimize its environmental impact. GRN-01 focuses on reducing energy consumption during transaction processing, while GRN-02 ensures that each transaction's carbon footprint is reported, promoting awareness. GRN-03 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient hardware, supporting a longer lifecycle and lower resource impact. GRN-04 ensures that transaction logging minimizes data storage requirements, which can reduce energy use. GRN-05 provides clients with electronic records to decrease paper waste. GRN-06 promotes automatic shutdown during inactivity to save energy. GRN-07 commits to annual assessments of environmental impacts, reinforcing accountability in sustainability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The application shall provide comprehensive transaction logs, including date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
The system shall prevent users from executing transactions that would create negative account balances after user confirmation.
The application shall validate user identity through a secure PIN entry mechanism.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available and with user confirmation.
The application shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds before processing.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data during transactions.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds, incorporating safety checks.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, ensuring safety protocols.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The system shall ensure that no account can enter a negative balance during transactions.
The system shall implement energy-efficient practices in user confirmation processes.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
